title: Shared feature review
description: Perform a final cross-cutting review of the completed notes feature for correctness, regression risk, test sufficiency, and alignment with the spec's locked decisions before merge.
acceptance_criteria: Review checks model, parser, renderer, and UI behavior against the spec's acceptance criteria and decisions locked in.
Review confirms shared testing and documentation outputs are complete and consistent with the implementation.
Review highlights any remaining risks, especially around strict dropping of unmodelled content and document save behavior.
Review outcome clearly states whether the feature is ready to merge or what blockers remain.
